payload.text:
I can see **versions 2, 3, and 4** of SOP-QC-001:

- **Version 2** — superseded; effective from 2024-03-01 to 2025-11-02.
- **Version 3** — **effective** from 2025-11-03.
- **Version 4** — draft and not yet effective.

Version 3 is the current effective version. It applies to readqc, somatic-snv, and germline-panel executions at every site: “It applies to readqc, somatic-snv and germline-panel executions at every site.” [sop-qc-001-v3@3:L4-L6]
What would the draft version change? Quote it.

result.text:
L1: # SOP-QC-001 v4: Read Quality and Low Purity Review
L2: Document: SOP-QC-001 | Version 4 | Status: draft | Effective: not yet effective
L3: Owner: quality lead | Approvers: qa-officer, lab-director
L4: > DRAFT for review under CHG-0024.
L5: > Not effective.
L6: > Do not use for routine work.
L7: ## 1. Purpose
L8: This procedure defines read quality review for libraries analyzed in the Zagent workbench.
L9: ## 2. Coverage
L10: Readqc fails when a selected library's coverage is below the confirmed minimum coverage.
L11: Normal and germline libraries require a mean coverage of at least 30x.
L12: Tumor libraries intended for somatic calling would require a mean coverage of at least 45x.
L13: The proposed 45x tumor minimum is based on the VAL-SOM-2025 low-VAF results and is still under review.
L14: ## 3. Sequencing Quality
L15: Libraries with a mapping rate below 95 percent are held for review.
L16: Duplication above 15 percent would fail readqc instead of only being recorded.
L17: The duplication rule needs an impact estimate from the bioinformatics team before approval.
L18: ## 4. Tumor Purity
L19: Tumor purity below 0.20 produces a warning because reduced sensitivity may affect interpretation.
L20: ## 5. Open Review Comments
L21: QA asks whether the 45x minimum should apply to RNA-only cases; it should not.
L22: The lab director asks for the expected increase in top-up sequencing before sign-off.
result.title: Read Quality and Low Purity Review
